script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(j.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       j.organization_id,
       j.idempotency_key,
       j.correlation_id,
       j.job_status,
       j.progress_percent,
       j.progress_message,
       j.attempt_count,
       j.cancel_requested,
       j.row_version,
       j.error_code,
       j.error_message,
       j.error_details,
       CAST(j.gd_id AS CHAR) AS gd_id,
       j.gd_no,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS update_time,
       DATE_FORMAT(j.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS finished_at,
       (j.lease_expires_at > n.t) AS lease_live,
       p3.step_status AS p3_status,
       p3.result_ref AS p3_ref,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step st
         WHERE st.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
           AND st.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND st.is_deleted = 0
           AND st.step_name IN ('P1_GD_HEADER', 'P2_GD_STRUCTURE', 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY', 'P6_PUBLICATION_BARRIER', 'P7A_OUTBOX_BLOCKED', 'P7B_GD_CREATED', 'P7B_SO_PROJECTION', 'P7C_OUTBOX_READY', 'P7D_JOB_COMMITTED')) AS steps_after_p0,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_operation op
         WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
           AND op.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
           AND op.source_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND op.is_deleted = 0
           AND op.operation_status <> 'REJECTED') AS ops_open,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inventory_operation op
         WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
           AND op.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
           AND op.source_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
           AND op.is_deleted = 0
           AND op.operation_status IN ('MUTATING', 'VERIFYING', 'REQUIRES_REVIEW')) AS ops_uncertain,
       (SELECT o2.operation_status FROM inventory_operation o2
         WHERE o2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
           AND o2.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
           AND o2.id = (SELECT MAX(op.id) FROM inventory_operation op
                         WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
                           AND op.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
                           AND op.source_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                           AND op.is_deleted = 0)) AS op_status,
       (SELECT o2.review_reference FROM inventory_operation o2
         WHERE o2.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
           AND o2.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
           AND o2.id = (SELECT MAX(op.id) FROM inventory_operation op
                         WHERE op.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
                           AND op.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
                           AND op.source_job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
                           AND op.is_deleted = 0)) AS op_review_ref,
       g.gd_status AS gd_status,
       g.delivery_no AS gd_live_no
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN gd_async_job j
    ON j.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
   AND j.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.organizationId}}'
   AND j.is_deleted = 0
   AND (j.id = {{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.jobIdSql}} OR j.idempotency_key = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.keySql}}')
  LEFT JOIN gd_publish_step p3
    ON p3.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
   AND p3.job_id = (CAST(j.id AS CHAR) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci)
   AND p3.step_name = 'P3_INVENTORY_APPLY'
   AND p3.is_deleted = 0
  LEFT JOIN goods_delivery g
    ON g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_vN1fxmgo.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.id = CAST(j.gd_id AS UNSIGNED)
   AND g.is_deleted = 0
